shared_holdout_comparison.interpretation: Primary methods share exactly the same original held-out 2D measurements. All-method comparison fixes B0 observed_uv and holdout mask, intersects finite predictions and every method time window. B4 may use different tracked coordinates internally; this fixed raw measurement reference is not independent GT.
